newsitem.title: USA: AMEX says mid-Jan short interest up 440,790-shares.
newsitem.headline: AMEX says mid-Jan short interest up 440,790-shares.

text.p: The American Stock Exchange reported Tuesday short interest of 121,762,585 shares as of the January 15 settlement date, compared with the 121,321,795 shares it reported in mid-December, an increase of 440,790 shares, the exchange said.
The January figure represents trades through January 10, the exchange added.
The year-ago figure totaled 100,725,375 shares, the exchange said.
